integrity: The 2*3^m zero-field count is credited to Priour, Gelfand and Sondhi, rather than claimed as new; finite checks supplement a combinatorial all-size proof.
scientific_limitations: Zero-temperature, classical longitudinal field, equal positive exchange and open boundaries only; no finite-temperature or transverse-field theorem. Historical priority outside examined sources is not certified.
title: Parity-selective longitudinal magnetization of open antiferromagnetic delta chains
